name: third-party-agent-current-binary-lifecycle
prompt: Run generate-context.sh, then spawn the fixture_external agent as task fixture_agent with instructions to read handoff-context.txt without inlining it. Wait for it, list its terminal status, interrupt it for cleanup, and finish.

files.generate-context.sh:
set -eu
{
  printf 'FILE_CONTEXT_BEGIN\n'
  index=0
  while [ "$index" -lt 2048 ]; do
    printf 'context-line-%04d: bounded file-backed handoff payload\n' "$index"
    index=$((index + 1))
  done
  printf 'FILE_CONTEXT_END\n'
} > handoff-context.txt
bytes=$(wc -c < handoff-context.txt | tr -d ' ')
printf 'FILE_CONTEXT_CREATED path=handoff-context.txt bytes=%s\n' "$bytes"
files.fixture-agent.sh:
set -eu
sleep 1
context_file=handoff-context.txt
bytes=$(wc -c < "$context_file" | tr -d ' ')
first=$(sed -n '1p' "$context_file")
last=$(tail -n 1 "$context_file")
printf 'FIXTURE_EXTERNAL_AGENT_COMPLETED cwd=%s context_bytes=%s first=%s last=%s prompt=%s\n' "$PWD" "$bytes" "$first" "$last" "$1"

config_toml:
model_provider = "harness"

[features.multi_agent_v2]
enabled = true
hide_spawn_agent_metadata = false

[agents.fixture_external]
description = "Deterministic external-command agent used only by the exec harness."

[agents.fixture_external.backend]
type = "external_command"
command = "/bin/sh"
protocol = "raw_cli"
args = ["fixture-agent.sh"]
timeout_ms = 5000

[model_providers.harness]
name = "Harness"
base_url = "{responses_base_url}"
wire_api = "responses"
requires_openai_auth = false
supports_websockets = false

item.name: spawn_agent
item.arguments: {"message":"Read handoff-context.txt from the workspace and return its byte count plus first and last markers. Do not inline the file into this message.","task_name":"fixture_agent","task_kind":"other","task_size":"normal","agent_type":"fixture_external","fork_turns":"none"}
